issues.finding: Nine video rows lack IDs and URLs.

issues.finding: Athina 53:26 is explicitly copied from schema example/notes.

issues.finding: Samples are capped at 30 recent uploads and mix clips, full sessions, promotion, teaching and non-ET context.

issues.finding: Relative age labels are heavily coarsened, with only three exact dates (two belong to unlinked videos).
issues.action: Keep date precision; use ranges or relative-age buckets and avoid precise upload-frequency inference.

issues.finding: Entity field sometimes reflects channel framing or content described by notes rather than literal title occurrence.
issues.action: Call these reported entity labels; separate title lexical counts from entity attribution.

issues.finding: No full transcript files are included; notes contain excerpts/paraphrases and links to third-party transcripts.
issues.action: Do not run those notes as a spoken transcript corpus or treat metadata topics as semantic speech results.

issues.finding: Audience figure is a supplied snapshot; Aluna row refers to a 1-video 1.58K backup account, not the 84.2K main account described in notes.
issues.action: Label actual account title/handle and mark unverified counters; no combined person audience.

issues.finding: Timeline contains mixed precision, scheduled future events, claimed predictions and lightly deduplicated historical events.
issues.action: Keep draft chronology separately until event type, dates and source claims are reviewed.

issues.finding: Original entity plot ranks counts across unequal samples and labels every row as latest uploads, though the source rollup also includes notes-only examples.
